title: How to Use Meta Ads MCP with Claude (And Why It's Not Enough) | Sprites
summary: One MCP URL connects Meta Ads to Claude or ChatGPT. Read ROAS and creative fatigue, draft new ads, and approve every write before it ships.
body_markdown:
## Why a connector like Sprites for Meta ads


The agent is the interface; the connector decides what it can see and what it is allowed to do. Six things change when that connector is Sprites.


### Advice that sees every channel


A Meta-only connector can only ever answer with Meta. Sprites reads Meta beside Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, GA4 and Shopify, so it can say the next $1,000 earns more on Google search than on a tired prospecting ad set — and propose the move as one approval.


[Every channel on one connector →](https://www.sprites.ai/mcp)


### No stake in your Meta budget


Meta earns more when you spend more on Meta. Sprites is priced per plan, not as a share of spend, so it earns the same whether it tells you to raise a budget, cut one, or move the money off Meta entirely.


### See what competitors are running


Ask for any advertiser and Sprites returns their live Meta ads, longest-running first, read as hooks, offers and formats rather than screenshots — then drafts tests for your account from what is clearly working for theirs.


[Browse the ads library →](https://www.sprites.ai/ads-library)


### It makes the ads, not just the campaign


Hooks, headlines, primary text and on-brand images, generated from your brand kit and previewed in the real Feed, Stories and Reels placements. Campaign, ad sets, audiences and creative arrive as one proposal.


### Connected the way Meta intends


Meta is connected once in Sprites through Meta’s own OAuth, with the standard ads scopes — ads_read, ads_management, business_management. No developer app, no system-user token pasted into a chat, and ChatGPT never holds a Meta credential. Calls are paced per ad account, so a busy agent cannot rate-limit you out of your own account.


### Built so agents can’t do unsafe things


Safety lives in the harness, native to ads — not in a prompt the model can ignore. Sprites catches edits that would reset Meta’s learning, changes only what the live account allows, forecasts every budget move, and checks every number against your data. Nothing ships without your approval.


### Safety built into the harness, native to ads


-


#### Protects the learning phase


Sprites reads every ad set’s learning stage before it touches anything, and flags the edits that would throw Meta’s delivery algorithm back into learning — so a quick tweak never costs you a week of optimization.


-


#### Safe edits, on live state


Every change is built from a fresh read of the account: which level owns the budget, which parent controls delivery, and whether Meta will accept the edit. No changes against a stale report, and a clear reason when an edit can’t be made.


-


#### Budget forecasting


Every budget change is forecast into the month before you approve it, so you see exactly where it lands. Switch on an enforced ceiling and anything that would break it is refused in code.


-


#### Anti-hallucination


Totals are computed in code and every figure is traced back to your account data. A number that doesn’t check out is withheld, not guessed.


-


#### Approval on every write


Every change arrives with its before and after, editable in place, and applies only when you approve it — with a record of who approved.


-


#### Native Meta permissions


Connected through Meta’s own OAuth with the standard ads scopes. Calls are paced per ad account so a busy agent never locks you out, and no credential ever enters the chat.
